body:
Reported Player(s): NationInsane

Rules Broken: Teamgreif, spleefing me off a bridge

Evidence: If I remember, spleefing your teammates was illegal, I wasn't able to take a picture of him breaking the glass block under me, but I got a picture of me falling and chat saying that "KikiSeung was spleefed out of the world by NationInsane"
{Yes I watched him break it, I was confused at first though.}

This was the message that I got after dying.


This was when he was watching me fall.


This is me falling. {Uncropped second picture}
